decision.answer: ADV_Elite decides what is interesting/anomalous and authors the canonical JSON itself. A trusted gateway only authenticates, verifies and publishes it to GitHub.

routing.anomaly: publish anomaly onset immediately to registry/anomalies/ADV_ELITE/YYYY/MM/DD/<anomaly_id>.json, then finalize episode bundle

security.gateway_to_github: fine-grained PAT for prototype or GitHub App installation token long-term
security.truth_guard: publication of an anomaly records detector output; it does not prove extraordinary physical causation

failure_mode.github_offline: keep registry_outbox locally or on storage-capable peer and retry later
failure_mode.duplicate_request: deduplicate by record_id + record/chunk hash and return prior ACK when known
